summary.text: Joe Timmons is a Democratic member of the Washington House of Representatives from District 42-Position 2, where he has served since December 2022, and he is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
He previously worked in Governor Jay Inslee's office as the Northwest Washington regional representative.

paragraphs.text: Joe Timmons grew up in a working-class household in Washington, where his parents opened a small mechanical contracting company out of their garage.
He graduated from Western Washington University in Bellingham and from the University of Washington's Evans School of Public Policy and Governance.
Ballotpedia lists a B.A. in political science and English from Western in 2007 and an M.P.A. from the Evans School in 2011.

Timmons spent about a decade working at the local, state and federal levels of government before joining the Legislature, most recently in Governor Inslee's office and earlier as Western Washington University's assistant director of government relations.
He has served on boards with the City of Bellingham and the Bellingham Food Bank.
He assumed office in the House on December 21, 2022.
He lives in Bellingham with his wife and their son.
